items.question: Hva betyr 48-timers godkjenningsgaranti?
items.answer: Det betyr at utleier eller ny boligkjøper har 48 timer på å inspisere arbeidet vårt. Skulle de finne noe som ikke oppfyller standarden, kommer vi tilbake og vasker på nytt helt gratis.

items.question: Er det noen ekstra kostnader utover prisen fra kalkulatoren?
items.answer: Nei, kalkulatorprisen inkluderer alt utstyr, vaskemidler, moms (MVA) og reisekostnader innenfor Notodden kommune. Ingen overraskende fakturagebyrer eller kjøretillegg.

items.question: Er renholderne deres forsikret og godkjent?
items.answer: Ja, Makarenko Reinhold is an approved cleaning enterprise registered with Arbeidstilsynet. Alle ansatte bærer HMS-kort, og vi har full ansvarsforsikring hos Gjensidige.

items.question: Can I pay with Vipps?
items.answer: Ja! Vi støtter full integrasjon med Vipps, i tillegg til tradisjonell faktura til e-post for bedrifter og privatpersoner.

items.question: Må jeg være til stede under vasken?
items.answer: Nei, du trenger ikke være til stede. Det enkleste er å avtale hvor nøklene kan hentes og leveres, eller gi oss en kode til nøkkelboks.

faq.title: Got questions about our services?
faq.subtitle: Here we have gathered answers to the most common questions regarding move-out cleaning, warranty, rates, and payment.

items.question: What does the 48-hour approval warranty mean?
items.answer: It means the landlord or buyer has 48 hours to inspect our work. If they find anything not up to par, we will return and clean it again completely free of charge.

items.question: Are there any extra costs besides the calculator price?
items.answer: No, the calculator price includes all equipment, cleaning products, VAT (MVA), and travel costs within Notodden municipality. No surprise invoicing fees.

items.question: Are your cleaners insured and officially approved?
items.answer: Yes, Makarenko Reinhold is a publicly approved cleaning enterprise registered with Arbeidstilsynet. All employees wear mandatory HMS cards, and we carry full insurance.

items.question: Can I pay using Vipps?
items.answer: Yes! We support full integration with Vipps, as well as traditional invoices sent to email for companies and private clients.

items.question: Do I need to be present during the clean?
items.answer: No, you don't need to be there. Simply let us know where keys can be fetched and returned, or provide us with a lockbox code.
